summaries.ko: 잠실 개표소 시위 현장에서 경찰관에게 침을 뱉은 40대 여성에게 법원이 지속적인 폭력 및 업무방해 전력과 재범 우려를 이유로 징역 10개월의 실형을 선고했습니다.
summaries.en: A 40-year-old woman who spat on a police officer during a protest at the Jamsil vote counting station was sentenced to 10 months in prison by the court, citing her history of violence and obstruction, and high risk of reoffending.
summaries.zh: 一名40多岁女性在蚕室计票站示威现场向警察吐口水，法院因其有持续的暴力、妨碍公务等前科且再犯可能性高，判处其10个月有期徒刑。

summaries.en: A 40-year-old woman who spat on a police officer during a protest at the Jamsil vote counting station has been sentenced to 10 months in prison.
